description: Performance Bar by JTA - The Data Scientist's Visualization Tool Overview Take your Power BI dashboards to the next level with the Performance Bar by JTA, a clean visual for tracking progress and status at a glance. Categories are displayed as streamlined horizontal bars with an optional markers and value label, making comparisons effortless effortless. With simple customization to match your theme - and an optional total bar - it delivers a clear, modern way to tell your performance story. Key Features: Bar customization: Configure bar height, colors, borders, and background to match your report theme. Flexible labeling: Show or hide individual labels and choose their position for clear, uncluttered reading. Adjustble scale: Change the scale to emphasize what matters most. Marker styling: Personalize circle markers (size, color, border) for highlights and targets. Marker styling: Personalize circle markers (size, color, border) for highlights and targets. Total Bar: Optionally display a summary bar fr an at-a-glance overall view. Configurable tooltips: Define exactly which fields appear and where tooltips show up. Subtle animation: Bring bars to life with a clean growth animation. If you have any doubts reach out to custom.visuals@thedatascientists.com.
